knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The lesson says to work generally from cleaner to dirtier areas and higher to lower surfaces, subject to the site procedure, to avoid rework.
Where a required control or instruction is unavailable, the worker seeks direction rather than substituting a control.
The plan zones and priorities section says to prepare clean supplies before entering a contaminated area.

practicalCriteria: Identifies relevant hazards, scope and site conditions
Selects and explains suitable controls and methods
Performs the sequence without unsafe contamination transfer
Verifies the outcome and documents exceptions
Escalates situations outside training or authority
passRule: Assessor must observe every safety-critical criterion; any failure requires remediation and reassessment.
evidenceRequired: Record of procedure step 4: Allow the product dwell times set by the product label, and keep wet areas protected until dry.
Record of procedure step 6: Close each zone by inspecting against the work order, addressing missed areas, cleaning equipment and recording exceptions before moving on.
stopWorkCriteria: Stop work if procedure step 5 is not done: Work each zone in the planned order, and stop and tell your supervisor if any stop-work condition applies.
